# Services, extend and admin conversion fixture (P7-SURF-13). See README.md for tags.
# Rows that write state non-idempotently, need the network, a database, a catalog or a running Admin
# (service enable/disable/add/upgrade/configure, add <plugin>, bundle rows, plugin info/search/updates/
# compat-check/audit-tables, admin health/start/projects add|remove) are covered by the Go tests in
# cmd/commands/json_extend_test.go. Moved spellings: the v1.4 row compares the pre-contract --json
# bytes with the base; the canonical-path row below it validates the v1.5 envelope.
config services
service list #| legacy-json no-json=envelope-checked-by-config-services-list
config services list
config services list --core
config services ps #| no-json=needs-a-docker-compose.yml-in-the-project-envelope-checked-by-TestServicesBodies
config services add myapi --dry-run
remove waf --dry-run
remove admin #| no-json=disabling-admin-breaks-registry-resolution-for-the-next-json-run-envelope-checked-by-TestExtendBodies
add admin

admin
